text:
marta: quick sync on bulk-rotate UX — posted new mock for rotating multiple keys at once. main questions: require typed confirmation for "shared" keys? how to handle empty-state when last key rotated?

marta: figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ZZZZ/bulk-rotate (bulk-rotate-modal v2)

lee: a11y first: typed confirmations are okay but make sure label + error messages are announced. avoid relying on color alone for status. For keyboard-only users, the confirm input must be reachable and clear.

sam: security: shared/team keys deserve stronger guardrails. suggestion: if any selected key is marked "shared" then show a required checkbox: "I understand rotating these keys may cause downtime". If rotating all keys for a project (i.e., last key), require typing the project slug.

raj: backend: we can issue a bulk-rotate transaction and return a bulk-undo token for 10s. snapshotting all keys pre-rotate is fine. cost negligible. Audit will list per-key rotate events.

jin: UI behavior idea: after rotate, dim rows and show status tag "rotated" with link to regenerate secret. Provide toast: '6 keys rotated. Undo' (10s). If user ends up on empty state, focus primary CTA 'Create key'. announce via aria-live: 'Project X has no API keys'.

marta: copy options — short vs detailed. Short: "Rotate 6 API keys? This will create new keys and may require updating deployed secrets. Undo available for 10s." Detailed adds per-env impact blurb. Which do we prefer?

sam: short is fine in modal. include a collapsed 'Details' section showing environments and example commands to update secrets (kubectl/ENV).

lee: accessibility nit: ensure modal has aria-describedby referencing the short copy and the warning. When the toast appears, it should be focusable and have aria-live='polite' so screen readers get the undo option.

marta: decision summary:
- modal copy: short version with collapsed details
- if any shared key selected: require checkbox confirmation.
- if rotating last key for project: require typed confirm (project slug).
- implement bulk snapshot + 10s bulk-undo token (raj ok)
- post-rotate toast: 'N keys rotated. Undo' focusable + polite aria-live
- empty state: show Create key primary button, focus it when user lands here, include link to rotate best practices doc

ops-bot: queued job #511: bulk-rotate-checks for branch feature/bulk-rotate — ETA ~12m.

marta: thanks team. jin will push prototype GIF and PR, lee will review a11y, raj will wire backend.

jin: will post PR later today with demo gif :rocket:
